### 1. What the user expresses / simulator behaviour
Genevieve Hollister (phone 5045550217, ZIP 70116; email only if one more detail is asked) wants to sign the remediation agreement today and pay whatever deposit Ridgecrest needs so the Monday 26 Oct start holds. She has no figure; she authorises anything that "has to be added to your job before the deposit can be worked out" without asking what; she signs and pays herself in the secure channel with the amount the agent states, by debit card, and reads back the confirmation. Insurance: public adjuster, Fairhaven Mutual, claim FMI-HO-26-2417. Simulator is passive (conveys needs, answers questions, runs the handed-over user tool).

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Pre-removal asbestos sampling line (book_mold_presample_d4275783): service_date = opened date 2026-10-21 ("the sampling line is dated the job's opened date").
Computation doc: line amount = standard-set charge (tier asbestos sampling fee; Extensive 595.00 in "Mold Remediation Lead-Safe and Asbestos Sampling Fee Sheet") + every other charge belonging to the line − every credit; rounded once.
Tiers found from records:
- Results reuse (doc "Reuse of Laboratory Results from a Linked Water Job"): linked water job's most recent asbestos_sampling line 2026-10-06, 15 days before opened date <= 365 -> standard-set charge = results review fee 85.00 (replaces 595.00). Found via the water job's charge line coded asbestos_sampling.
- Era material set (doc "Era Material Sample Sets"): age = whole months 1948-01-01 -> 2026-10-21 = 945, /12 = 78 >= 75, living area -> +145.00. Found via year_built + growth_location.
- Claim documentation (doc "Claim Documentation Sample Sets"): claim file names a public adjuster -> +110.00 split set. Found via public_adjuster_name.
- Contaminated water handling (doc "Sample Handling Behind Contaminated Water Losses"): category_3 -> +90.00.
- Lab turnaround (doc "Asbestos Laboratory Turnaround Tariff"): lead time 2026-10-26 − 2026-10-21 = 5 days -> 72-hour, +95.00.
- Water crew collection credit (doc "Sample Collection by the Water Crew"): drying_start 2026-10-07 <= opened, no drying complete -> −75.00.
Amount = 85 + 145 + 110 + 90 + 95 − 75 = **450.00**. Fall-back (computation doc only): 595.00.

(b) Work-plan visit line (book_mold_workplan_1501986a): service_date = opened date 2026-10-21.
Computation doc: base visit hours 2 × tier supervisor rate (Extensive 97.65, labor schedule); visit hours = site-walk hours + every other hour scheduled; summed, multiplied, rounded once.
- Walk hours (doc "Work-Plan Walk Hours by Mapped Water Footprint"): water affected_area_sqft 420 > 300 -> 3 + 0.5 × ceil(120/100)=2 steps = 4.0 h (replaces the 2 h walk).
- Claim coordination (doc "Claim Coordination Time"): PA named -> +0.5.
- Moisture verification (doc "Moisture Verification"): drying started 10-07, not complete on 10-21 -> +0.5.
- Overhead survey (doc "Ceiling and Wall Survey Time"): class_3 -> +1.0.
- Regulated-material planning (doc "Lead and Asbestos Planning Time"): water lead_safe_setup line dated 2026-10-07 <= opened -> +1.0.
- Work-plan lead time (doc "Work-Plan Lead-Time Hours Schedule"): 5 days -> +0.25.
Hours 7.25 × 97.65 = 707.9625 -> **707.96**. Fall-back: 2 × 97.65 = 195.30.

(c) Signing deposit (sign_mold_agreement_2b99f603, deposit_amount):
Computation doc: tier self-pay deposit (Extensive 1500.00) + every charge line booked at signing − customer payments; assembly: credit off the self-pay deposit first (floor 0), then raises/prepayments added, booked lines added, payments subtracted, floor 0, round once.
- Coverage credit (doc "Claim Coverage Credit"): approved file, mold sublimit 1000.00 > 0 -> credit 1000.00 -> 1500 − 1000 = 500.00.
- Route raise (doc "Carrier Payment Route Raise"): PA named -> +300.00 (independent of the direct-payment property).

- Short notice (doc "Short-Notice Raise"): 2026-10-26 − 2026-10-23 = 3 days -> +100.00.

- Booked lines 450.00 + 707.96 = 1157.96; customer payments on this job 0.
Deposit = 500 + 300 + 250 + 100 + 395 + 1157.96 = **2702.96**. payment_method debit_card (no surcharge).
Fall-back (computation doc only, after the two lines at their own fall-backs): 1500 + 595 + 195.30 = 2290.30; with the factored lines: 2657.96. Both differ from 2702.96.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
- Root: sign agreement + pay deposit (customer-owned).
- Hop A (sampling line before deposit) — **state-derived**: signing hub sentence "fixed only after the job's charge lines carry the pre-removal asbestos sampling owed on a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff" + year_built 1948 + find_mold_charges (no asbestos_sampling line) -> searched "asbestos sampling mold year built" -> "Pre-Removal Asbestos Sampling on Mold Remediation Jobs" ("A Mold Remediation job in a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff carries a pre-removal asbestos sampling line") which carries its own booking tool.
- Hop B (work-plan visit before deposit) — **state-derived**: "not worked out until the job's charge lines carry the work-plan visit owed on a tier that requires a protocol" + Extensive protocol row "Yes" + no supervisor_labor line -> "The Remediation Work-Plan Visit on Mold Remediation Jobs" ("Every Mold Remediation job on a tier that requires a protocol carries one work-plan visit line").
- Neither depended-on hub states a prerequisite of its own; nothing further. Order: A and B (any order) -> root.
- No hop pre-solved: the signing documents name no other tool or route.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the signing": the deposit is "fixed only after" / "not worked out until" the two lines exist; a deposit stated without them would be a figure the rule says is not settled, and it would also omit the booked-lines term of the deposit rule.
- Closest alternatives excluded: no deposit for insurance jobs (retired clause 6); claim-file deductible not involved; route raise 200 excluded because a PA is named ("A file that names a public adjuster" -> 300 in either direct-payment column); Category 2 figures excluded by category_3; lab rush excluded (lead time 5 > 2); deposit notice counted from signing date (today), not opened date (that would be 5 -> still 100; same result); water-crew partial credit excluded (drying started). Lead prepayment 345 vs 395: the doc says "the tier's lead-safe setup fee", and every mold doc uses "the tier" for the Mold Remediation job's tier -> 395.00.
